{{Top|leg}}
The '''Spokesmind''' was a position held by the unofficial leader of the [[Hoojib/Legends|Hoojibs]] of [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]]. As the Hoojibs were [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] creatures, they spoke directly into the minds of other [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]]. The spokesmind was selected as the Hoojib who would "speak" for the entire species. Near the end of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the spokesmind was [[Plif/Legends|Plif]], who greeted the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] when they arrived on Arbra.
